verdict.rationale: Dagster exposes a documented Python API (dg.asset, dg.AssetExecutionContext), a CLI (dg, create-dagster), a Dagster+ MCP server, and AI-agent skills for coding agents, giving strong programmatic/agentic access. However, an OpenAPI/REST spec probe returned 404s across all candidate endpoints, and there's no evidence of a documented public REST/GraphQL API for general external driving beyond the Python SDK/CLI/MCP. missing for 10: a documented REST/OpenAPI/GraphQL public API, independent hands-on confirmation of AI-agent usage via MCP/CLI in practice.
